head: heavy split
notes: AMK lists 103329 as 1/2 heavy split lock washer (AMK B-11346, also cross-refs 9420963). AMK row finish column says phosphate & oil while description says mech zinc; NCRS reply says 1033xx washers originally 'plain' finish. Second (forum) mention of 1/2 heavy seen in search summary only, URL not confirmed.
